key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as a fourth RBA rate hike looms; house prices forecast to fall up to 10% (headlines 48, 62, 76)
CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since budget, signalling credit contraction (headline 64)
Iron ore sector faces a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical demand (headline 50)
Bass Oil confirms new oil pay at Bunian 6, Indonesia; TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling (headlines 2, 66)
Small-cap miners active: Kaoko Metals, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals in focus (headlines 30, 39, 40)
Bathla collapse exposes fragility in Australian construction sector; ratings agencies flag Victoria's debt (headlines 44, 45, 51)
EV sales overtake petrol cars for first time in Australia, reshaping energy and consumer dynamics (headline 41)
US jobs blowout raises Fed hike fears, pressuring global risk assets and AUD (headlines 5, 13)

sectors.trend: Bearish. CBA flags 15% drop in home loan applications; banks forecast record house price falls. ASIC whistleblower review adds governance overhang. CBA/Westpac fee practices under scrutiny.
sectors.implications: NIM pressure from credit contraction; elevated NPL risk in residential mortgage book. Defensive positioning warranted for CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX.

sectors.trend: Mixed. Iron ore shakeout underway (headline 50) pressures BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX. Small-caps active: Kaoko Metals, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals. Macarthur clears WA iron ore bulk test hurdle.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners face margin compression; small-cap explorers offer speculative upside but carry high execution risk. Gold (Aurum) benefits from safe-haven flows.

sectors.trend: Constructive for upstream. Bass Oil new oil pay in Indonesia; TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling. Energy transition costs mounting (headline 70). Beetaloo gas cartel concerns (headline 72).
sectors.implications: Bass Oil (BOL.AX) and TMK Energy (TMK.AX) see positive catalysts. Energy transition cost overhang pressures WES.AX, AGL.AX, IGW.AX.

sectors.trend: EV sales surpass petrol cars for first time; hidden costs (charging, battery) emerging. Fuel cost avoidance driving demand shift.
sectors.implications: Long-term tailwind for EV infrastructure and battery supply chains; near-term margin pressure on fuel retailers (WES.AX, AGL.AX).

sectors.trend: Bearish. Bathla collapse signals sector-wide fragility; housing construction to follow prices lower. Melbourne councils admit infrastructure cannot cope with population growth.
sectors.implications: Downside risk for construction names and property-linked REITs. Housing downturn pressures VGP.AX, DGL.AX, SGP.AX.

sectors.trend: Nvidia confirms AI boom persists; cybersecurity demand rising. Australia faces AI worker and tradie shortage, prompting skilled migration push.
sectors.implications: Positive for global tech exposure; domestic AI/tech names limited but data centre build-out (Insteel, Daktronics themes) relevant to ASX infrastructure plays.

key_themes: RBA fourth rate hike risk and credit contraction
Housing downturn: 10% price fall forecast, 15% loan application drop
Iron ore structural shakeout amid geopolitical demand
Energy transition cost overhang vs upstream exploration wins
Construction sector fragility (Bathla) and sovereign debt concerns (Victoria)
EV adoption inflection point in Australia
Small-cap mining activity and gold safe-haven flows
US jobs blowout and Fed hike fears pressuring global risk appetite

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike and credit contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce financials and REIT exposure; favour cash-yielding defensives; monitor RBA statement for forward guidance.
Underweight residential REITs and construction; favour industrial and healthcare REITs with contracted tenancies.
Diversify away from pure-play iron ore; favour gold and diversified miners (BHP.AX, NCM.AX).

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US Fed rate hike / global risk-off
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; maintain liquidity; monitor DXY and 10Y UST yields.
Avoid high-leverage construction and property developers; monitor ASIC and ratings agency updates.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: El Niño cyclone risk to energy/infrastructure
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review insurance coverage on energy assets; monitor AEMO and state grid operators.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and diversified miners as safe-haven and iron ore hedge
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore shakeout pressures pure-plays; gold benefits from rate uncertainty and safe-haven demand. Aurum adding high-grade ounces.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective upstream energy exposure on exploration catalysts
opportunities.rationale: Bass Oil new oil pay and TMK Energy gas rate surge provide idiosyncratic upside; energy transition cost overhang creates relative value.

opportunities.recommendation: EV infrastructure and battery supply chain positioning
opportunities.rationale: EV sales overtaking petrol cars is a structural inflection; long-term demand tailwind for charging, grid, and battery names.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential REIT and construction exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house price fall forecast, 15% loan application drop, Bathla collapse signal sector-wide stress.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim large-cap bank exposure pending RBA decision
defensive_moves.rationale: Credit contraction and NPL risk rising; ASIC whistleblower review adds governance uncertainty.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash and short-duration bonds as rate-hike hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Fourth RBA hike loom; US Fed also on alert; liquidity premium justified.

market_outlook.short_term: Cautious-to-negative. ASX likely to remain under pressure ahead of a probable fourth RBA hike. Housing data and credit contraction dominate. Iron ore weakness caps materials. Small-cap mining provides pockets of upside. Expect elevated volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but uneven. EV transition, energy exploration, and gold offer structural themes. Housing correction may be a 12–18-month process. RBA likely to pivot once inflation cools, supporting a late-2026/early-2027 recovery. Iron ore shakeout may create M&A opportunities.
